title: Firehose PutRecordBatch HTTP API, client & backpressure

user_story.i_want: to send records to Firehose over HTTP like PutRecordBatch and be told when Firehose is overloaded
user_story.so_that: producers get backpressure instead of silent drops

description: stratum-firehose exposes `POST /v1/streams/{stream}/records` (a JSON array of up to 500 records, up to 4 MiB) and enqueues into that stream's channel. An unknown stream gets 404. A full channel gets 429 with Retry-After. The success body mirrors Firehose: `{failed_put_count, request_responses[]}`. In the ingest API, implement `RecordSink` as `FirehoseClient` (one shared reqwest::Client, configurable timeout). The ingest API returns 503 + Retry-After when Firehose says 429, and `/readyz` checks Firehose's `/healthz`.

acceptance_criteria.when: I POST valid records to the ingest API
acceptance_criteria.then: within buffer_interval a gzip object containing them appears in stratum-raw
Firehose answers 429 and the ingest API answers 503 with Retry-After
/readyz returns 503, POST returns 503, and nothing panics

acceptance_criteria.when: a contract test runs against a stub server
acceptance_criteria.then: request/response shapes and timeout behaviour are verified
